verdict.rationale: OpenRouter is fundamentally an API product: extensive documented REST API (chat completions, model listing, key management, streaming, tool calling), an OpenAPI spec confirmed live, a keyless models endpoint verified returning 426 models, an OpenAI-SDK-compatible interface, and even an MCP server for agentic tool use. Community confirms real-world programmatic use (switching models, fallbacks, key management) despite some support/reliability gripes unrelated to API existence.
